A circular defensive layout as described in earlier sections cannot be employed 
universally. The tendency to have bookish, geometrical pattern should be curbed according to the ground senario. A circular layout is ideal only for a circular VP which can be attacked from all directions. Normal layouts must conform to the shape of OCA/ TCA/ VP/ VA being defended and must be based on full appreciation of the terrain around the VP and pattern of attack adopted by the enemy. AD defences required forethought and clear understanding of AD employment. After initial deployment and assessment of the defences it is essential that constant evaluation be made of the pattern of attack and layout modified or changed to make them more effective. AD must be flexible and aggressive, making full use of deception, decoys and dummy positions to surprise the enemy. Rigidity must be avoided.
